answer: Each bonded identity can appear independent, but correlated equivocation links their signed messages: for k coordinated identities, the protocol accounts for up to k(k−1)/2 culpable pairs, making penalties scale as O(k²). If a sybil swarm is detected, an additional exponential multiplier on forfeited escrow makes capital loss grow sharply with swarm size; names like meadow, falcon, and cedar do not hide common control. Asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery of the full stake.
